1719-2645-3257-3430.easyPrerequisites: Vizier of Tumbling Sands doesn't have summoning sickness.
1719-2645-3257-3430.description:
Activate Rakdos Carnarium by tapping it, adding {B}{B}{B}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Rakdos Carnarium
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2023-4518-6006-7175.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

618-728-3991.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token.
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

240-5295-5470-6495.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat from step 2.
240-5295-5470-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1874-1981-2415-5256.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1874-1981-2415-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1687-5256-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1718-3168-4477-7182.description:
Cast Greenwarden of Murasa for its evoke cost by paying {2} due to Urza's Incubator.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Catalyst Elemental from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa with haste.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Catalyst Elemental by paying {R} due to Urza's Incubator.
Activate Catalyst Elemental by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Catalyst Elemental dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Catalyst Elemental with haste.
Activate the Catalyst Elemental token by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.
1718-3168-4477-7182.notes: If you have at least {2}{R} in your mana pool on a particular iteration, step 10 can be skipped.

4766-5231-6730-7091.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sin, adding {R}.
When Sin dies, it, Heirloom Blade and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Heirloom Blade trigger, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature that shares a card type with Sin and put it into your hand
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Activate Heirloom Blade's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the creature.
Repeat.
4766-5231-6730-7091.notes: The returned creature may be Sin or not. If it isn't, simply ignore the trigger shuffling it into your library, and replace all instances of Sin with the returned creature for that iteration.

4798-5631-5686-7178.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4798-5631-5686-7178.description:
Activate Iron-Shield Elf by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a 2/2 Skeleton Pirate creature token.
Repeat.

57-1753-4846-6657.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-1753-4846-6657.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2267-3705-5231-6896.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Squee and the creature token, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.battlefieldCardState: without a -1/-1 counter on it without a -1/-1 counter on it

671-5670-6792--5.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 2 or higher.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
671-5670-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Daxos trigger.
Resolve the Daxos trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

2558-5687-5692-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Weapons Trainer, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

1339-2558-5330-6666.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-2558-5330-6666.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Insect.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Rook Turret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Atog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to loot.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to an indestructible creature you control

514-2723.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to the indestructible creature.
514-2723.description:
Activate The Mycosynth Gardens' third ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Blazing Sunsteel.
Activate The Mycosynth Gardens' equip ability by paying {4}, attaching it to the creature that has Blazing Sunsteel attached.
Deal damage to the creature with Blazing Sunsteel and The Mycosynth Gardens attached.
Blazing Sunsteel and The Mycosynth Gardens trigger.
Resolve the Blazing Sunsteel trigger, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve the Mycosynth Gardens trigger, dealing damage to the creature.
Repeat from step 4.

2577-3967-6462.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

requires.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blcoked and killed by an opponent

1879-3259--95.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and the creature with mobilize as attackers, triggering the creature with mobilize, creating at least one 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Warrior token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
1879-3259--95.notes: If you choose a creature with mobilize 2 or higher, this combo makes extra Warrior tokens each loop.

1636-2857-2921.notablePrerequisites:
Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
1636-2857-2921.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature targeted in step 1.
When the creature dies, Adarkar Valkyrie triggers, returning the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

413-4871-5695-5752.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Infested Thrinax trigger, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Brokkos.
When Brokkos dies, Infested Thrinax and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Infested Thrinax trigger, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
When the Saprolings enter the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers that many times.
Resolve a Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 11, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 10 three additional times.
Resolve all remaining Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U/B}{G}{G}.
Cast Brokkos from your graveyard for its mutate cost by paying {2}{U/B}{G}{G}, putting it on top of a Saproling.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2366-2757-5702.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Dryad Arbor.
1270-2366-2757-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control at least one basic Forest, or the land card in your hand is a basic Forest.
1270-2366-2757-5702.description:
Play any land from your hand, ensuring to play a basic Forest if you have one in hand.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create three token copies of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers three times.
Holding priority, activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Dryad Arbor token, untapping the basic Forest.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 one additional time.
Resolve the first and second Springheart Nantuko triggers, choosing not to pay and creating six 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create three token copies of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 3.

575-2860--19.description:
Activate Proteus Machine's morph ability by paying {0}, turning it face-up.
Proteus Machine triggers, causing it to become a Saproling.
Activate the sacrifice outlet by sacrificing Proteus Machine.
When Proteus Machine dies, Yedora triggers, returning Proteus Machine from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the sacrifice outlet's ability.
Activate Proteus Machine by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

2452-2921-4484.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
2452-2921-4484.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ebondeath, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Repeat.

1794-2292-4424.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one black card in hand.
1794-2292-4424.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ruthless Ripper.
When Ruthless Ripper dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Ruthless Ripper from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Ruthless Ripper's morph ability by revealing a black card from your hand, turning it face up.
Ruthless Ripper triggers, causing target player to lose 2 life.
Repeat.

73-4050-4424.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Daru Mender, adding {W}.
When Daru Mender dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Daru Mender from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Daru Mender's morph ability by paying {W}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

1182-2557-4321-5270.description:
Cast Stonecoil Serpent by paying {0}.
Stonecoil Serpent enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Samwise triggers, creating four Food artifact tokens.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing three Foods, returning Stonecoil Serpent to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

90-1981-4378.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
You have a way to cause the additional creature to die.
"Soldier" chosen with Engineered Plague.
90-1981-4378.description:
Cause the additional creature to die.
Sanguinary Priest triggers, dealing 1 damage to you and causing you to gain one life.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
The Soldier enters the battlefield as a 0/0 due to Engineered Plague and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Repeat from step 2.

142-1379-2719.notablePrerequisites: Saheeli Rai has at least two loyalty counters on it.
142-1379-2719.description:
Activate Saheeli Rai's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, creating a token copy of itself that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
Repeat.

851-1455-1810-2523.description:
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying {1}{U}{U}, targeting Adrix and Nev.
Vesuvan Duplimancy triggers, creating two nonlegendary token copies of Adrix and Nev.
Resolve Cackling Counterpart, creating eight copies of Adrix and Nev.
Put all but one legendary Adrix and Nev into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Adrix and Nevs die, Ratadrabik triggers eight times.
Resolve the first Ratadrabik trigger, creating a number of nonlegendary token copies of Adrix and Nev equal to 2^(the number of Adrix and Nevs you currently control) that are 2/2 Zombies in addition to their other types.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.

1608-3008-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1608-3008-4659.description:
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the creature it is attached to to become a copy of Triplicate Titan.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the creature with Blade of Shared Souls attached, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, it triggers, creating three 3/3 Golem creature tokens.
Repeat.

1912-2978-4499-5313.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {1}, blinking Bookwurm.
Bookwurm enters the battlefield, causing you to gain three life and draw a card.
Activate Treasonous Ogre by paying three life, adding {R}.
Repeat.

2034-3035-4871.manaNeeded: {3} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
2034-3035-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have cast Nadier no more than three times from the command zone this game.
2034-3035-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Nadier, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Nadier to the command zone from your graveyard.
Nadier dies, triggering its second ability and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Nadier trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Elf Warrior creature tokens equal to its power.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Nadier from the command zone by paying {5}{B} and command tax, if applicable.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Elf Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
The Elf Warrior dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer and Nadier's first ability.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Nadier trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 8 for each remaining Elf Warrior.
Repeat from step 1.

1110-3356.description:
Cast Polyraptor by paying {6}{G}{G}.
When Polyraptor enters the battlefield, Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing 5 damage to Polyraptor.
Polyraptor dies as a state-based action due to lethal damage.
Polyraptor triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Repeat from step 2 using the new Polyraptor token instead.

2034-2557-5189.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-2557-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature token, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat.
